mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower borrowing costs and increased liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger immediate equity selling pressure, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months where UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or the signal fails to outperform the baseline in 80% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer and business spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through elevated corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a rolling 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 320), the Federal Reserve's aggressive tightening policy leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real rates rise and growth fears intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 320, or the signal's predictive power is not significant (p>0.05) in a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over the past 3 months signals strong consumer spending, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through immediate revenue boosts for consumer-facing companies.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS has increased for 3 consecutive months, or the signal's Rank IC remains below 0.03 in any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 for two consecutive months, it indicates manufacturing contraction that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced corporate output and earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 100 for two consecutive months, or the signal's predictive accuracy drops below 55% in walk-forward testing.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), a monthly payroll growth rate (PAYEMS) exceeding 0.5% signals labor market tightness that fuels inflation and prompts monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% and UNRATE is below 3.5%, or the signal fails to outperform the market in 80% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 3 months signals strong residential construction activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through immediate sector revenue growth and broader economic confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST has increased for 3 consecutive months, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window.
